summary: The delivered batch contains a conditional shortcut: both repeated rank-3 questions qualify A, so learners can skip inspecting A. The other seven checks passed. Package files remain unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Identify matrices with a specified rank by inspecting dimensions and independent pivots.
reasoning_steps: Reject matrices with fewer than the requested number of rows or columns.
Inspect remaining matrices for independent pivots.
Select the qualifying matrix or subset using the supplied answer controls.
invariants: Rank cannot exceed either matrix dimension.
Rank equals the pivot count in row echelon form.
Prompts, answers and solutions must follow the same matrices.
Eligible winning labels are incidental source assignments.
permitted_variations: Change eligible qualifying labels and subsets.
Change visible pivot structures while retaining inspection difficulty.
Vary harmless coefficients, labels and option order.
source_refs: Tutorial c062d466-946c-526b-aba8-0a0895671218 (4151): rank counts pivots in row echelon form.

source_replay.details: Ten complete source profiles replayed: 15 fields and 54 choices. Missing keys, solutions and canonical bank evidence are explicitly documented.

math.details: Independent exact elimination checked 69 records; no incorrect answers or tested solution rank assertions were found.

variety.details: The finite catalog contains meaningful rank-role changes across ten complete profiles. The delivered batch's conditional defect is assessed separately.

scope.details: Source-backed inspection workloads and response contracts are retained.

grading.details: Native grading matched 376 general acceptance/rejection expectations and eight additional shortcut probes.

rendering.details: Eighteen actual-UI renders were inspected, including every runner record and both counterfactual types.

packaging.details: Declared-only relocation and deterministic replay passed. Installed dependency versions match. The retained import regression passes current code and rejects its restored failing fixture.

decision_variation.details: All five runner records survive delivery filtering. In the repeated rank-3 subgroup with B excluded, hardcoding A and inspecting only C succeeds 2/2. Same-subgroup catalog controls defeat this strategy in two of six cases.

findings.description: The delivered subgroup with target rank 3, matrix shapes 2×4/3×4/5×5, and B dimension-excluded always qualifies A. Its answers are A-only and A+C-only. Learners can hardcode A and inspect only C, bypassing one required rank decision. This is a batch-selection defect; the larger generator contains counterexamples.
findings.reproduction: Run `python3 -B check_batch_decisions.py --input batch.json --report batch-regression.json`; it exits 1. Minimal records are 30778945-23df-50b0-95ba-a8bed6b6d058 (seed 0; matches [A], assignment [C,A,B], scale 2) and b47f067d-9b6e-563f-be93-6367ac2f712e (seed 0; matches [A,C], assignment [A,C,B], scale 2). Both shortcut responses are accepted by the native grader; complete records are retained in minimal-failing-batch.json.
findings.requested_change: Change batch selection to check eligible-label variation within recognizable profile and dimension-exclusion subgroups after filtering.
